// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

// В Remix включите: Enable optimization (runs=200 или 1) + Enable viaIR

interface IERC20 {
    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
}

interface ITokenReceiver {
    function onTokenReceived(address token, address creator, uint256 amount) external;
}

contract PolygonHybridAMM is ITokenReceiver {
    // ---- Кастомные ошибки (вместо строк в require) ----
    error Reentrant();
    error OnlyRouter();
    error OnlyAdmin();
    error TransferFailed();
    error TransferFromFailed();
    error InvalidToken();
    error InvalidCreator();
    error ZeroAmount();
    error AlreadyInit();
    error BadDecimals();
    error InsufficientBalance();
    error AmountTooSmall();
    error NotRegistered();
    error NotCreator();
    error ZeroRef();
    error SelfRef();
    error AlreadySet();
    error NothingToClaim();
    error ZeroTo();
    error NoFee();
    error UnsupportedToken();
    error Nothing();
    error NoExcess();
    error NoPool1();
    error NoPool2();
    error OnlyUsdcDai();
    error InsufficientLiquidity();
    error NotEnoughX();
    error NoRealStable();
    error InvalidOutput();
    error NotEnoughDai();

    bool private _locked;

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        if (_locked) revert Reentrant();
        _locked = true;
        _;
        _locked = false;
    }

    address public constant ROUTER = 0x2C312e36015c634fbD5067ca67B29c8Ec1ce2204;

    modifier onlyRouter() {
        if (msg.sender != ROUTER) revert OnlyRouter();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        if (msg.sender != admin) revert OnlyAdmin();
        _;
    }

    function _safeTransfer(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = address(token).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        if (!(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))))) revert TransferFailed();
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = address(token).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)
        );
        if (!(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))))) revert TransferFromFailed();
    }

    IERC20 public constant USDC = IERC20(0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174);
    IERC20 public constant DAI  = IERC20(0x8f3Cf7ad23Cd3CaDbD9735AFf958023239c6A063);

    uint256 public constant VIRTUAL_RESERVE = 10000 * 10**18;
    uint256 public constant DEFAULT_CAP_LEVEL18 = 100_000 * 10**18;

    uint256 public constant BUY_FEE_BPS_HIGH     = 3000;
    uint256 public constant BUY_FEE_BPS_LOW      = 100;
    uint256 public constant TOTAL_SELL_FEE_BPS   = 100;
    uint256 public constant REF_SHARE_BPS        = 5000;
    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR      = 10000;

    address public immutable admin;

    mapping(address => address) public referrer;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refCount;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceUSDC18;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceDAI18;

    uint256 public projectFeeUSDC18;
    uint256 public projectFeeDAI18;

    struct Pool {
        address tokenX;
        uint256 reserveX;
        uint256 virtualY;
        uint256 realUSDC18;
        uint256 realDAI18;
        bool exists;
    }

    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX1;
    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX2;

    mapping(address => address) public tokenCreator;
    mapping(address => uint256) public marketCapThreshold18;

    event PoolCreated(address indexed tokenX, uint256 reserveX, uint256 virtualY, uint8 poolType);
    event SwapExecuted(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenX,
        uint8 poolType,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 priceBefore,
        uint256 priceAfter
    );
    event ReservesUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 reserveX, uint256 realUSDC18, uint256 realDAI18);
    event PriceUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 price);
    event UserTrade(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, bool isBuy, uint256 volumeUSD);
    event MarketCapThresholdUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint256 threshold18);
    event TokenInitialized(address indexed token, address indexed creator, uint256 amountX1, uint256 amountX2);
    event ReferralSet(address indexed user, address indexed referrer);
    event ReferralReward(address indexed referrer, address indexed user, address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ReferralClaimed(address indexed referrer, uint256 usdcPaid, uint256 daiPaid);
    event ProjectFeeAccrued(address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ProjectFeeWithdrawn(address token, address to, uint256 amount18);

    modifier onlyPoolX1(address tokenX) {
        if (!poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert NoPool1();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyPoolX2(address tokenX) {
        if (!poolX2[tokenX].exists) revert NoPool2();
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        admin = msg.sender;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Точка входа от роутера
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function onTokenReceived(
        address token,
        address creator,
        uint256 amount
    ) external override nonReentrant onlyRouter {
        if (token == address(0) || token == address(USDC) || token == address(DAI)) revert InvalidToken();
        if (creator == address(0)) revert InvalidCreator();
        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
        if (poolX1[token].exists || poolX2[token].exists) revert AlreadyInit();

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("decimals()"));
        if (!(ok && data.length >= 32)) revert BadDecimals();
        if (abi.decode(data, (uint256)) != 18) revert BadDecimals();

        uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        if (balance < amount) revert InsufficientBalance();

        uint256 amountX1 = amount / 2;
        uint256 amountX2 = amount - amountX1;
        if (amountX1 == 0 || amountX2 == 0) revert AmountTooSmall();

        tokenCreator[token] = creator;
        marketCapThreshold18[token] = DEFAULT_CAP_LEVEL18;

        poolX1[token] = Pool(token, amountX1, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);
        poolX2[token] = Pool(token, amountX2, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);

        emit PoolCreated(token, amountX1, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 1);
        emit PoolCreated(token, amountX2, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 2);
        emit MarketCapThresholdUpdated(token, DEFAULT_CAP_LEVEL18);
        emit TokenInitialized(token, creator, amountX1, amountX2);

        _emitPoolState(token, true);
        _emitPoolState(token, false);
    }

    function setMarketCapThreshold(address tokenX, uint256 newThreshold18) external {
        if (tokenCreator[tokenX] == address(0)) revert NotRegistered();
        if (msg.sender != tokenCreator[tokenX]) revert NotCreator();
        marketCapThreshold18[tokenX] = newThreshold18;
        emit MarketCapThresholdUpdated(tokenX, newThreshold18);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Рефералка
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function setReferrer(address _ref) external {
        if (_ref == address(0)) revert ZeroRef();
        if (_ref == msg.sender) revert SelfRef();
        if (referrer[msg.sender] != address(0)) revert AlreadySet();
        referrer[msg.sender] = _ref;
        refCount[_ref] += 1;
        emit ReferralSet(msg.sender, _ref);
    }

    function claimReferralRewards() external nonReentrant {
        uint256 usdcAmt18 = refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender];
        uint256 daiAmt18 = refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender];
        if (usdcAmt18 == 0 && daiAmt18 == 0) revert NothingToClaim();

        refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender] = 0;
        refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender] = 0;

        uint256 usdcPaid = 0;
        uint256 daiPaid = 0;

        if (usdcAmt18 > 0) {
            usdcPaid = usdcAmt18 / 10**12;
            if (usdcPaid > 0) _safeTransfer(USDC, msg.sender, usdcPaid);
        }
        if (daiAmt18 > 0) {
            daiPaid = daiAmt18;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, msg.sender, daiPaid);
        }
        emit ReferralClaimed(msg.sender, usdcPaid, daiPaid);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Комиссия проекта
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function withdrawProjectFee(address token, address to) external nonReentrant onlyAdmin {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroTo();
        if (token == address(USDC)) {
            uint256 amt18 = projectFeeUSDC18;
            if (amt18 == 0) revert NoFee();
            projectFeeUSDC18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, to, amt18 / 10**12);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, amt18);
        } else if (token == address(DAI)) {
            uint256 amt18 = projectFeeDAI18;
            if (amt18 == 0) revert NoFee();
            projectFeeDAI18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, to, amt18);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, amt18);
        } else {
            revert UnsupportedToken();
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Аварийный вывод
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function emergencyRescue(address token, address to) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroTo();
        uint256 bal = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        if (bal == 0) revert Nothing();

        if (!poolX1[token].exists && !poolX2[token].exists) {
            _safeTransfer(IERC20(token), to, bal);
            return;
        }
        uint256 reserved = poolX1[token].reserveX + poolX2[token].reserveX;
        if (bal <= reserved) revert NoExcess();
        _safeTransfer(IERC20(token), to, bal - reserved);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Торговые функции
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function buyX1(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX1(tokenX) {
        if (!poolX2[tokenX].exists) revert NoPool2();
        _buy(tokenX, tokenIn, amountIn, true);
    }

    function buyX2(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX2(tokenX) {
        if (!poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert NoPool1();
        _buy(tokenX, tokenIn, amountIn, false);
    }

    function sellX1(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX1(tokenX) {
        _sell(tokenX, amountX, true);
    }

    function sellX2(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX2(tokenX) {
        _sell(tokenX, amountX, false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Покупка
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _buy(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, bool usePoolX1) internal {
        if (tokenIn != address(USDC) && tokenIn != address(DAI)) revert OnlyUsdcDai();
        if (amountIn == 0) revert ZeroAmount();

        uint256 amountForPool18;
        {
            uint256 amt18 = (tokenIn == address(USDC)) ? amountIn * 10**12 : amountIn;
            uint256 feeBps = _getBuyFeeBps(tokenX, usePoolX1);
            uint256 fee18 = (amt18 * feeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            amountForPool18 = amt18 - fee18;

            uint256 refFee18 = (fee18 * REF_SHARE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            _accrueTradeFees(tokenIn, refFee18, fee18 - refFee18);
        }

        Pool storage pool = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        uint256 amountXOut;
        {
            uint256 newReserveX;
            uint256 priceBefore;
            uint256 priceAfter;
            (amountXOut, newReserveX, priceBefore, priceAfter) = _calculateBuy(pool, amountForPool18);

            pool.reserveX = newReserveX;
            if (tokenIn == address(USDC)) {
                pool.realUSDC18 += amountForPool18;
            } else {
                pool.realDAI18 += amountForPool18;
            }

            _emitSwap(tokenX, usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2, true, amountIn, amountXOut, priceBefore, priceAfter);
        }

        _safeTransferFrom(IERC20(tokenIn), msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
        _safeTransfer(IERC20(tokenX), msg.sender, amountXOut);

        emit UserTrade(msg.sender, tokenX, usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2, true, amountIn);
        _emitPoolState(tokenX, usePoolX1);
        _emitPrice(tokenX, usePoolX1);
    }

    function _getBuyFeeBps(address tokenX, bool usePoolX1) internal view returns (uint256) {
        Pool storage p = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (!p.exists || p.reserveX == 0) return BUY_FEE_BPS_HIGH;

        uint256 effectiveY = p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18;
        uint256 totalSupply = IERC20(tokenX).totalSupply();
        uint256 marketCap18 = (effectiveY * totalSupply) / p.reserveX;

        return marketCap18 >= marketCapThreshold18[tokenX] ? BUY_FEE_BPS_LOW : BUY_FEE_BPS_HIGH;
    }

    function _calculateBuy(Pool storage pool, uint256 amountForPool18)
        internal
        view
        returns (uint256 amountXOut, uint256 newReserveX, uint256 priceBefore, uint256 priceAfter)
    {
        uint256 reserveX = pool.reserveX;
        uint256 oldEffectiveY = pool.virtualY + pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        priceBefore = reserveX > 0 ? oldEffectiveY / reserveX : 0;

        uint256 k = reserveX * oldEffectiveY;
        uint256 newY = oldEffectiveY + amountForPool18;
        newReserveX = k / newY;
        amountXOut = reserveX - newReserveX;
        if (amountXOut == 0 || amountXOut >= reserveX) revert InsufficientLiquidity();

        priceAfter = newReserveX > 0 ? newY / newReserveX : 0;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Продажа
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _sell(address tokenX, uint256 amountX, bool usePoolX1) internal {
        if (amountX == 0) revert ZeroAmount();

        Pool storage pool = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (amountX >= pool.reserveX) revert NotEnoughX();

        uint256 stableOut18;
        uint256 newReserveX;
        uint256 priceBefore;
        uint256 priceAfter;
        {
            (stableOut18, newReserveX, priceBefore, priceAfter) = _calculateSell(pool, amountX);
        }

        uint256 userOut18;
        {
            uint256 totalFee = (stableOut18 * TOTAL_SELL_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            uint256 refFee18 = (totalFee * REF_SHARE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            uint256 projFee18 = totalFee - refFee18;
            userOut18 = stableOut18 - totalFee;

            pool.reserveX = newReserveX;
            _deductAndAccrueSellFees(pool, refFee18, projFee18);
        }

        _safeTransferFrom(IERC20(tokenX), msg.sender, address(this), amountX);
        _payoutStable(pool, msg.sender, userOut18);

        uint8 poolType = usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2;
        _emitSwap(tokenX, poolType, false, amountX, userOut18, priceBefore, priceAfter);
        emit UserTrade(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, false, userOut18);
        _emitPoolState(tokenX, usePoolX1);
        _emitPrice(tokenX, usePoolX1);
    }

    function _calculateSell(Pool storage pool, uint256 amountX)
        internal
        view
        returns (uint256 stableOut18, uint256 newReserveX, uint256 priceBefore, uint256 priceAfter)
    {
        uint256 oldRealY = pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        uint256 effectiveY = pool.virtualY + oldRealY;
        uint256 reserveX = pool.reserveX;

        priceBefore = reserveX > 0 ? effectiveY / reserveX : 0;

        uint256 k = reserveX * effectiveY;
        newReserveX = reserveX + amountX;
        uint256 newEffectiveY = k / newReserveX;
        if (newEffectiveY <= pool.virtualY) revert NoRealStable();

        uint256 newRealY = newEffectiveY - pool.virtualY;
        stableOut18 = oldRealY - newRealY;
        if (stableOut18 == 0 || stableOut18 > oldRealY) revert InvalidOutput();

        priceAfter = newReserveX > 0 ? newEffectiveY / newReserveX : 0;
    }

    function _payoutStable(Pool storage pool, address user, uint256 stableOut18) internal {
        uint256 usdc18 = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (stableOut18 <= usdc18) {
            pool.realUSDC18 = usdc18 - stableOut18;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, user, stableOut18 / 10**12);
        } else {
            pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, user, usdc18 / 10**12);
            uint256 remaining = stableOut18 - usdc18;
            if (pool.realDAI18 < remaining) revert NotEnoughDai();
            pool.realDAI18 -= remaining;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, user, remaining);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Начисление комиссий
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _accrueTradeFees(address tokenIn, uint256 refFee18, uint256 projFee18) internal {
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];

        if (tokenIn == address(USDC)) {
            if (projFee18 > 0) {
                projectFeeUSDC18 += projFee18;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), projFee18);
            }
            if (refFee18 > 0) {
                if (ref != address(0)) {
                    refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += refFee18;
                    emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(USDC), refFee18);
                } else {
                    projectFeeUSDC18 += refFee18;
                    emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), refFee18);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (projFee18 > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += projFee18;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), projFee18);
            }
            if (refFee18 > 0) {
                if (ref != address(0)) {
                    refBalanceDAI18[ref] += refFee18;
                    emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(DAI), refFee18);
                } else {
                    projectFeeDAI18 += refFee18;
                    emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), refFee18);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function _deductAndAccrueSellFees(Pool storage pool, uint256 refFee18, uint256 projFee18) internal {
        if (projFee18 > 0) {
            (uint256 projUSDC, uint256 projDAI) = _deductStableFromPool(pool, projFee18);
            if (projUSDC > 0) {
                projectFeeUSDC18 += projUSDC;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), projUSDC);
            }
            if (projDAI > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += projDAI;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), projDAI);
            }
        }
        if (refFee18 == 0) return;

        (uint256 refUSDC, uint256 refDAI) = _deductStableFromPool(pool, refFee18);
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];
        if (ref != address(0)) {
            if (refUSDC > 0) {
                refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += refUSDC;
                emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(USDC), refUSDC);
            }
            if (refDAI > 0) {
                refBalanceDAI18[ref] += refDAI;
                emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(DAI), refDAI);
            }
        } else {
            if (refUSDC > 0) {
                projectFeeUSDC18 += refUSDC;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), refUSDC);
            }
            if (refDAI > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += refDAI;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), refDAI);
            }
        }
    }

    function _deductStableFromPool(Pool storage pool, uint256 amount18)
        internal
        returns (uint256 usdcPart, uint256 daiPart)
    {
        uint256 usdcBal = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (amount18 <= usdcBal) {
            pool.realUSDC18 = usdcBal - amount18;
            return (amount18, 0);
        } else {
            pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
            uint256 remaining = amount18 - usdcBal;
            if (pool.realDAI18 < remaining) revert NotEnoughDai();
            pool.realDAI18 -= remaining;
            return (usdcBal, remaining);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Вспомогательные эмиты
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _emitSwap(
        address tokenX,
        uint8 poolType,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 priceBefore,
        uint256 priceAfter
    ) internal {
        emit SwapExecuted(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, isBuy, amountIn, amountOut, priceBefore, priceAfter);
    }

    function _emitPoolState(address tokenX, bool isX1) internal {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        emit ReservesUpdated(tokenX, isX1 ? 1 : 2, p.reserveX, p.realUSDC18, p.realDAI18);
    }

    function _emitPrice(address tokenX, bool isX1) internal {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (p.reserveX > 0) {
            uint256 price = (p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18) / p.reserveX;
            emit PriceUpdated(tokenX, isX1 ? 1 : 2, price);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Минимум view (остальное читается из public mappings)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function getActualStableBalances() external view returns (uint256 usdcBalance, uint256 daiBalance) {
        usdcBalance = USDC.balanceOf(address(this));
        daiBalance = DAI.balanceOf(address(this));
    }
}

Проблема в размере кода: 28 175 байт при лимите 24 576. Нужно срезать ~3.6 КБ. Самое эффективное — **заменить строки в `require` на кастомные ошибки** (каждая строка ~30–50 байт, у вас их десятки) и **убрать дублирующие view-функции** (их можно читать прямо из public mapping).

Ниже — оптимизированная версия. Плюс обязательно в Remix: **optimizer ✅ runs = 200** и **viaIR ✅**. Если после этого всё ещё не влезает — поставьте runs = 1.

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

// В Remix включите: Enable optimization (runs=200 или 1) + Enable viaIR

interface IERC20 {
    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
}

interface ITokenReceiver {
    function onTokenReceived(address token, address creator, uint256 amount) external;
}

contract PolygonHybridAMM is ITokenReceiver {
    // ---- Кастомные ошибки (вместо строк в require) ----
    error Reentrant();
    error OnlyRouter();
    error OnlyAdmin();
    error TransferFailed();
    error TransferFromFailed();
    error InvalidToken();
    error InvalidCreator();
    error ZeroAmount();
    error AlreadyInit();
    error BadDecimals();
    error InsufficientBalance();
    error AmountTooSmall();
    error NotRegistered();
    error NotCreator();
    error ZeroRef();
    error SelfRef();
    error AlreadySet();
    error NothingToClaim();
    error ZeroTo();
    error NoFee();
    error UnsupportedToken();
    error Nothing();
    error NoExcess();
    error NoPool1();
    error NoPool2();
    error OnlyUsdcDai();
    error InsufficientLiquidity();
    error NotEnoughX();
    error NoRealStable();
    error InvalidOutput();
    error NotEnoughDai();

    bool private _locked;

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        if (_locked) revert Reentrant();
        _locked = true;
        _;
        _locked = false;
    }

    address public constant ROUTER = 0x2C312e36015c634fbD5067ca67B29c8Ec1ce2204;

    modifier onlyRouter() {
        if (msg.sender != ROUTER) revert OnlyRouter();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        if (msg.sender != admin) revert OnlyAdmin();
        _;
    }

    function _safeTransfer(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = address(token).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transfer.selector, to, amount)
        );
        if (!(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))))) revert TransferFailed();
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = address(token).call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)
        );
        if (!(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))))) revert TransferFromFailed();
    }

    IERC20 public constant USDC = IERC20(0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174);
    IERC20 public constant DAI  = IERC20(0x8f3Cf7ad23Cd3CaDbD9735AFf958023239c6A063);

    uint256 public constant VIRTUAL_RESERVE = 10000 * 10**18;
    uint256 public constant DEFAULT_CAP_LEVEL18 = 100_000 * 10**18;

    uint256 public constant BUY_FEE_BPS_HIGH     = 3000;
    uint256 public constant BUY_FEE_BPS_LOW      = 100;
    uint256 public constant TOTAL_SELL_FEE_BPS   = 100;
    uint256 public constant REF_SHARE_BPS        = 5000;
    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR      = 10000;

    address public immutable admin;

    mapping(address => address) public referrer;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refCount;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceUSDC18;
    mapping(address => uint256) public refBalanceDAI18;

    uint256 public projectFeeUSDC18;
    uint256 public projectFeeDAI18;

    struct Pool {
        address tokenX;
        uint256 reserveX;
        uint256 virtualY;
        uint256 realUSDC18;
        uint256 realDAI18;
        bool exists;
    }

    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX1;
    mapping(address => Pool) public poolX2;

    mapping(address => address) public tokenCreator;
    mapping(address => uint256) public marketCapThreshold18;

    event PoolCreated(address indexed tokenX, uint256 reserveX, uint256 virtualY, uint8 poolType);
    event SwapExecuted(
        address indexed user,
        address indexed tokenX,
        uint8 poolType,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 priceBefore,
        uint256 priceAfter
    );
    event ReservesUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 reserveX, uint256 realUSDC18, uint256 realDAI18);
    event PriceUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, uint256 price);
    event UserTrade(address indexed user, address indexed tokenX, uint8 poolType, bool isBuy, uint256 volumeUSD);
    event MarketCapThresholdUpdated(address indexed tokenX, uint256 threshold18);
    event TokenInitialized(address indexed token, address indexed creator, uint256 amountX1, uint256 amountX2);
    event ReferralSet(address indexed user, address indexed referrer);
    event ReferralReward(address indexed referrer, address indexed user, address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ReferralClaimed(address indexed referrer, uint256 usdcPaid, uint256 daiPaid);
    event ProjectFeeAccrued(address token, uint256 amount18);
    event ProjectFeeWithdrawn(address token, address to, uint256 amount18);

    modifier onlyPoolX1(address tokenX) {
        if (!poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert NoPool1();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyPoolX2(address tokenX) {
        if (!poolX2[tokenX].exists) revert NoPool2();
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        admin = msg.sender;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Точка входа от роутера
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function onTokenReceived(
        address token,
        address creator,
        uint256 amount
    ) external override nonReentrant onlyRouter {
        if (token == address(0) || token == address(USDC) || token == address(DAI)) revert InvalidToken();
        if (creator == address(0)) revert InvalidCreator();
        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();
        if (poolX1[token].exists || poolX2[token].exists) revert AlreadyInit();

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = token.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSignature("decimals()"));
        if (!(ok && data.length >= 32)) revert BadDecimals();
        if (abi.decode(data, (uint256)) != 18) revert BadDecimals();

        uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        if (balance < amount) revert InsufficientBalance();

        uint256 amountX1 = amount / 2;
        uint256 amountX2 = amount - amountX1;
        if (amountX1 == 0 || amountX2 == 0) revert AmountTooSmall();

        tokenCreator[token] = creator;
        marketCapThreshold18[token] = DEFAULT_CAP_LEVEL18;

        poolX1[token] = Pool(token, amountX1, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);
        poolX2[token] = Pool(token, amountX2, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 0, 0, true);

        emit PoolCreated(token, amountX1, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 1);
        emit PoolCreated(token, amountX2, VIRTUAL_RESERVE, 2);
        emit MarketCapThresholdUpdated(token, DEFAULT_CAP_LEVEL18);
        emit TokenInitialized(token, creator, amountX1, amountX2);

        _emitPoolState(token, true);
        _emitPoolState(token, false);
    }

    function setMarketCapThreshold(address tokenX, uint256 newThreshold18) external {
        if (tokenCreator[tokenX] == address(0)) revert NotRegistered();
        if (msg.sender != tokenCreator[tokenX]) revert NotCreator();
        marketCapThreshold18[tokenX] = newThreshold18;
        emit MarketCapThresholdUpdated(tokenX, newThreshold18);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Рефералка
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function setReferrer(address _ref) external {
        if (_ref == address(0)) revert ZeroRef();
        if (_ref == msg.sender) revert SelfRef();
        if (referrer[msg.sender] != address(0)) revert AlreadySet();
        referrer[msg.sender] = _ref;
        refCount[_ref] += 1;
        emit ReferralSet(msg.sender, _ref);
    }

    function claimReferralRewards() external nonReentrant {
        uint256 usdcAmt18 = refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender];
        uint256 daiAmt18 = refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender];
        if (usdcAmt18 == 0 && daiAmt18 == 0) revert NothingToClaim();

        refBalanceUSDC18[msg.sender] = 0;
        refBalanceDAI18[msg.sender] = 0;

        uint256 usdcPaid = 0;
        uint256 daiPaid = 0;

        if (usdcAmt18 > 0) {
            usdcPaid = usdcAmt18 / 10**12;
            if (usdcPaid > 0) _safeTransfer(USDC, msg.sender, usdcPaid);
        }
        if (daiAmt18 > 0) {
            daiPaid = daiAmt18;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, msg.sender, daiPaid);
        }
        emit ReferralClaimed(msg.sender, usdcPaid, daiPaid);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Комиссия проекта
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function withdrawProjectFee(address token, address to) external nonReentrant onlyAdmin {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroTo();
        if (token == address(USDC)) {
            uint256 amt18 = projectFeeUSDC18;
            if (amt18 == 0) revert NoFee();
            projectFeeUSDC18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, to, amt18 / 10**12);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, amt18);
        } else if (token == address(DAI)) {
            uint256 amt18 = projectFeeDAI18;
            if (amt18 == 0) revert NoFee();
            projectFeeDAI18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, to, amt18);
            emit ProjectFeeWithdrawn(token, to, amt18);
        } else {
            revert UnsupportedToken();
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Аварийный вывод
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function emergencyRescue(address token, address to) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroTo();
        uint256 bal = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        if (bal == 0) revert Nothing();

        if (!poolX1[token].exists && !poolX2[token].exists) {
            _safeTransfer(IERC20(token), to, bal);
            return;
        }
        uint256 reserved = poolX1[token].reserveX + poolX2[token].reserveX;
        if (bal <= reserved) revert NoExcess();
        _safeTransfer(IERC20(token), to, bal - reserved);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Торговые функции
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function buyX1(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX1(tokenX) {
        if (!poolX2[tokenX].exists) revert NoPool2();
        _buy(tokenX, tokenIn, amountIn, true);
    }

    function buyX2(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX2(tokenX) {
        if (!poolX1[tokenX].exists) revert NoPool1();
        _buy(tokenX, tokenIn, amountIn, false);
    }

    function sellX1(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX1(tokenX) {
        _sell(tokenX, amountX, true);
    }

    function sellX2(address tokenX, uint256 amountX) external nonReentrant onlyPoolX2(tokenX) {
        _sell(tokenX, amountX, false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Покупка
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _buy(address tokenX, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, bool usePoolX1) internal {
        if (tokenIn != address(USDC) && tokenIn != address(DAI)) revert OnlyUsdcDai();
        if (amountIn == 0) revert ZeroAmount();

        uint256 amountForPool18;
        {
            uint256 amt18 = (tokenIn == address(USDC)) ? amountIn * 10**12 : amountIn;
            uint256 feeBps = _getBuyFeeBps(tokenX, usePoolX1);
            uint256 fee18 = (amt18 * feeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            amountForPool18 = amt18 - fee18;

            uint256 refFee18 = (fee18 * REF_SHARE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            _accrueTradeFees(tokenIn, refFee18, fee18 - refFee18);
        }

        Pool storage pool = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        uint256 amountXOut;
        {
            uint256 newReserveX;
            uint256 priceBefore;
            uint256 priceAfter;
            (amountXOut, newReserveX, priceBefore, priceAfter) = _calculateBuy(pool, amountForPool18);

            pool.reserveX = newReserveX;
            if (tokenIn == address(USDC)) {
                pool.realUSDC18 += amountForPool18;
            } else {
                pool.realDAI18 += amountForPool18;
            }

            _emitSwap(tokenX, usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2, true, amountIn, amountXOut, priceBefore, priceAfter);
        }

        _safeTransferFrom(IERC20(tokenIn), msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
        _safeTransfer(IERC20(tokenX), msg.sender, amountXOut);

        emit UserTrade(msg.sender, tokenX, usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2, true, amountIn);
        _emitPoolState(tokenX, usePoolX1);
        _emitPrice(tokenX, usePoolX1);
    }

    function _getBuyFeeBps(address tokenX, bool usePoolX1) internal view returns (uint256) {
        Pool storage p = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (!p.exists || p.reserveX == 0) return BUY_FEE_BPS_HIGH;

        uint256 effectiveY = p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18;
        uint256 totalSupply = IERC20(tokenX).totalSupply();
        uint256 marketCap18 = (effectiveY * totalSupply) / p.reserveX;

        return marketCap18 >= marketCapThreshold18[tokenX] ? BUY_FEE_BPS_LOW : BUY_FEE_BPS_HIGH;
    }

    function _calculateBuy(Pool storage pool, uint256 amountForPool18)
        internal
        view
        returns (uint256 amountXOut, uint256 newReserveX, uint256 priceBefore, uint256 priceAfter)
    {
        uint256 reserveX = pool.reserveX;
        uint256 oldEffectiveY = pool.virtualY + pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        priceBefore = reserveX > 0 ? oldEffectiveY / reserveX : 0;

        uint256 k = reserveX * oldEffectiveY;
        uint256 newY = oldEffectiveY + amountForPool18;
        newReserveX = k / newY;
        amountXOut = reserveX - newReserveX;
        if (amountXOut == 0 || amountXOut >= reserveX) revert InsufficientLiquidity();

        priceAfter = newReserveX > 0 ? newY / newReserveX : 0;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Продажа
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _sell(address tokenX, uint256 amountX, bool usePoolX1) internal {
        if (amountX == 0) revert ZeroAmount();

        Pool storage pool = usePoolX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (amountX >= pool.reserveX) revert NotEnoughX();

        uint256 stableOut18;
        uint256 newReserveX;
        uint256 priceBefore;
        uint256 priceAfter;
        {
            (stableOut18, newReserveX, priceBefore, priceAfter) = _calculateSell(pool, amountX);
        }

        uint256 userOut18;
        {
            uint256 totalFee = (stableOut18 * TOTAL_SELL_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            uint256 refFee18 = (totalFee * REF_SHARE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
            uint256 projFee18 = totalFee - refFee18;
            userOut18 = stableOut18 - totalFee;

            pool.reserveX = newReserveX;
            _deductAndAccrueSellFees(pool, refFee18, projFee18);
        }

        _safeTransferFrom(IERC20(tokenX), msg.sender, address(this), amountX);
        _payoutStable(pool, msg.sender, userOut18);

        uint8 poolType = usePoolX1 ? 1 : 2;
        _emitSwap(tokenX, poolType, false, amountX, userOut18, priceBefore, priceAfter);
        emit UserTrade(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, false, userOut18);
        _emitPoolState(tokenX, usePoolX1);
        _emitPrice(tokenX, usePoolX1);
    }

    function _calculateSell(Pool storage pool, uint256 amountX)
        internal
        view
        returns (uint256 stableOut18, uint256 newReserveX, uint256 priceBefore, uint256 priceAfter)
    {
        uint256 oldRealY = pool.realUSDC18 + pool.realDAI18;
        uint256 effectiveY = pool.virtualY + oldRealY;
        uint256 reserveX = pool.reserveX;

        priceBefore = reserveX > 0 ? effectiveY / reserveX : 0;

        uint256 k = reserveX * effectiveY;
        newReserveX = reserveX + amountX;
        uint256 newEffectiveY = k / newReserveX;
        if (newEffectiveY <= pool.virtualY) revert NoRealStable();

        uint256 newRealY = newEffectiveY - pool.virtualY;
        stableOut18 = oldRealY - newRealY;
        if (stableOut18 == 0 || stableOut18 > oldRealY) revert InvalidOutput();

        priceAfter = newReserveX > 0 ? newEffectiveY / newReserveX : 0;
    }

    function _payoutStable(Pool storage pool, address user, uint256 stableOut18) internal {
        uint256 usdc18 = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (stableOut18 <= usdc18) {
            pool.realUSDC18 = usdc18 - stableOut18;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, user, stableOut18 / 10**12);
        } else {
            pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
            _safeTransfer(USDC, user, usdc18 / 10**12);
            uint256 remaining = stableOut18 - usdc18;
            if (pool.realDAI18 < remaining) revert NotEnoughDai();
            pool.realDAI18 -= remaining;
            _safeTransfer(DAI, user, remaining);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Начисление комиссий
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _accrueTradeFees(address tokenIn, uint256 refFee18, uint256 projFee18) internal {
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];

        if (tokenIn == address(USDC)) {
            if (projFee18 > 0) {
                projectFeeUSDC18 += projFee18;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), projFee18);
            }
            if (refFee18 > 0) {
                if (ref != address(0)) {
                    refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += refFee18;
                    emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(USDC), refFee18);
                } else {
                    projectFeeUSDC18 += refFee18;
                    emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), refFee18);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (projFee18 > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += projFee18;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), projFee18);
            }
            if (refFee18 > 0) {
                if (ref != address(0)) {
                    refBalanceDAI18[ref] += refFee18;
                    emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(DAI), refFee18);
                } else {
                    projectFeeDAI18 += refFee18;
                    emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), refFee18);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function _deductAndAccrueSellFees(Pool storage pool, uint256 refFee18, uint256 projFee18) internal {
        if (projFee18 > 0) {
            (uint256 projUSDC, uint256 projDAI) = _deductStableFromPool(pool, projFee18);
            if (projUSDC > 0) {
                projectFeeUSDC18 += projUSDC;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), projUSDC);
            }
            if (projDAI > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += projDAI;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), projDAI);
            }
        }
        if (refFee18 == 0) return;

        (uint256 refUSDC, uint256 refDAI) = _deductStableFromPool(pool, refFee18);
        address ref = referrer[msg.sender];
        if (ref != address(0)) {
            if (refUSDC > 0) {
                refBalanceUSDC18[ref] += refUSDC;
                emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(USDC), refUSDC);
            }
            if (refDAI > 0) {
                refBalanceDAI18[ref] += refDAI;
                emit ReferralReward(ref, msg.sender, address(DAI), refDAI);
            }
        } else {
            if (refUSDC > 0) {
                projectFeeUSDC18 += refUSDC;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(USDC), refUSDC);
            }
            if (refDAI > 0) {
                projectFeeDAI18 += refDAI;
                emit ProjectFeeAccrued(address(DAI), refDAI);
            }
        }
    }

    function _deductStableFromPool(Pool storage pool, uint256 amount18)
        internal
        returns (uint256 usdcPart, uint256 daiPart)
    {
        uint256 usdcBal = pool.realUSDC18;
        if (amount18 <= usdcBal) {
            pool.realUSDC18 = usdcBal - amount18;
            return (amount18, 0);
        } else {
            pool.realUSDC18 = 0;
            uint256 remaining = amount18 - usdcBal;
            if (pool.realDAI18 < remaining) revert NotEnoughDai();
            pool.realDAI18 -= remaining;
            return (usdcBal, remaining);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Вспомогательные эмиты
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function _emitSwap(
        address tokenX,
        uint8 poolType,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 priceBefore,
        uint256 priceAfter
    ) internal {
        emit SwapExecuted(msg.sender, tokenX, poolType, isBuy, amountIn, amountOut, priceBefore, priceAfter);
    }

    function _emitPoolState(address tokenX, bool isX1) internal {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        emit ReservesUpdated(tokenX, isX1 ? 1 : 2, p.reserveX, p.realUSDC18, p.realDAI18);
    }

    function _emitPrice(address tokenX, bool isX1) internal {
        Pool storage p = isX1 ? poolX1[tokenX] : poolX2[tokenX];
        if (p.reserveX > 0) {
            uint256 price = (p.virtualY + p.realUSDC18 + p.realDAI18) / p.reserveX;
            emit PriceUpdated(tokenX, isX1 ? 1 : 2, price);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Минимум view (остальное читается из public mappings)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function getActualStableBalances() external view returns (uint256 usdcBalance, uint256 daiBalance) {
        usdcBalance = USDC.balanceOf(address(this));
        daiBalance = DAI.balanceOf(address(this));
    }
}
```

## Что изменилось и почему это уменьшит размер

1. **Все `require(..., "строка")` заменены на кастомные ошибки.** Каждая строка вида `"Pool X1 does not exist"` в байткоде занимает ~30–50 байт (плюс обвязка `revert`), а кастомная ошибка — всего 4 байта (селектор). Это даёт экономию ~2.5–3 КБ.

2. **Убраны 10 дублирующих view-функций:**
   - `getPoolBalances`, `getTokenPrice`, `getTotalLiquidity`, `getPoolState`, `getFullPoolInfo` — их всё равно пересчитывает фронтенд из `poolX1(token)` / `poolX2(token)`.
   - `getPoolX1`, `getPoolX2` — полностью дублируют авто-геттеры public-маппингов `poolX1` / `poolX2` (Solidity сам делает геттер, возвращающий `(tokenX, reserveX, virtualY, realUSDC18, realDAI18, exists)`).
   - `getReferrer` — дублирует авто-геттер `referrer`.
   - `getReferralBalance`, `getProjectFeeBalance` — тоже читаются напрямую из public-переменных.
   
   Оставлен только `getActualStableBalances` — просто удобная пара вызовов `balanceOf`.

   Экономия: ещё ~1–1.5 КБ.

3. **Логика полностью сохранена** — те же суммы, те же комиссии, те же эмиты, тот же сплит 50/50.

## Что делать во фронтенде вместо удалённых view

```js
// Пул X1
const [tokenX, reserveX, virtualY, realUSDC18, realDAI18, exists] =
    await amm.poolX1(tokenAddress);

// Пул X2 — то же самое через amm.poolX2(tokenAddress)

// Цена (18 dec): 
// price = (virtualY + realUSDC18 + realDAI18) / reserveX

// Реферер юзера:
const ref = await amm.referrer(user);

// Балансы реферала:
const usdc18 = await amm.refBalanceUSDC18(ref);
const dai18  = await amm.refBalanceDAI18(ref);

// Комиссии проекта:
const projUsdc18 = await amm.projectFeeUSDC18();
const projDai18  = await amm.projectFeeDAI18();
```

## Настройки компилятора

Обязательно в Remix → Solidity Compiler → **Advanced Configurations**:

- ✅ **Enable optimization** — `runs = 200`. Если всё равно не влезает — `runs = 1`.
- ✅ **Enable viaIR** — обязателен, иначе `Stack too deep`.

После этих изменений + оптимизатора контракт должен уложиться в лимит (обычно получается ~20–23 КБ). Если у вас всё ещё будет превышение — напишите итоговое число байт, добью дальше (можно вынести `_accrueTradeFees` / `_deductAndAccrueSellFees` в отдельную библиотеку или объединить их).
